name: pulse-desktop
description: Pulse: a menu bar app in Tauri, the files read in Rust, the panel in ui/

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix ui install && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
scripts.test: cd src-tauri && cargo test && cd ../.. && python3 -I tools/test_check_private.py
scripts.icons: python3 make_icons.py && python3 make_tray.py && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/source.png
